caption:
ChatGPT just changed how it hands you work. As of this week, the new model behind ChatGPT — GPT-6 Astra — can build a finished document, spreadsheet, or presentation directly inside the chat, not just draft the words for you to paste into Word or Canva.

For a proposal or quote, that means you can ask for the finished file in one message and get something close to send-ready, instead of writing the text then formatting it yourself.

Try this prompt the next time a client wants a quote fast:

"Write a one-page proposal for [client name] covering: the problem, the scope, three deliverables, timeline, and price of $[X]. Format it as a clean document with headers, not a wall of text."

The catch: it's still guessing at your formatting preferences and your numbers. Read every figure before it goes anywhere near a client's inbox — a wrong price or an invented deliverable costs you the deal, not just time.

Save this for the next time a client needs a quote by end of day.
